desc:
🌴 Coastville RP – live your best life in a sunny seaside city!
🏡 Claim a FREE house or rent a skyscraper apartment with city views. Decorate it your way, lock the doors, and invite friends and family over.
💼 Choose from 20+ jobs: police officer, firefighter, doctor, teacher, chef, mayor and more. Get to work and earn paychecks!
🚗 Drive 25+ vehicles, from school buses and fire engines to monster trucks and hypercars.
🐾 Adopt pets, from ducklings to a giant bunny.
👗 Create any look with the full avatar catalog, save outfits, and dance with thousands of UGC emotes.
🏫 Explore the high school, hospital, daycare, farm, pier and downtown skyline.

👍 Like & ⭐ favorite to get new updates!
